releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.3 introduces HWM Terminal v1 in service 0.2.5.2. Authenticated Headline technician commands use the existing outbound HWM heartbeat channel with no inbound listener. Terminal.Run supports one-shot PowerShell or CMD, a maximum 60 second runtime, bounded output, short command expiry, operator audit identity and process-tree termination on timeout. Existing Mesh recovery watchdog behaviour from 0.2.5.2 is unchanged. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
